propositions: Remove three deprecated single-pass review public entry points: CLI verb rebar review, library rebar.llm.review_ticket wrapper, and MCP tool review_ticket.
The internal engine _review_ticket_impl must remain because it has two live consumers in review_workflows.py and eval_solver.py.
Review result schema and output schema wiring must be preserved and re-pointed to review-code producer instead of deleted.
Deprecation registry rows must be deleted and the removal recorded in the historical NOTE block in src/rebar/_deprecations.py.
Generated documentation (cli-reference.md, mcp-reference.md) must be regenerated via scripts and server.json MCP manifest mirror must be resynced.
All 19 test files referencing removed surfaces must be retargeted to review-plan paths or deleted (shim suite tests/unit/test_cli_review_alias.py removed wholesale).
